quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: The approach for a left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof.

activation.condition: driver intends a left turn at an intersection and both intersecting highways are two-directional

obligation.description: approach for the left turn in the portion of the right half of the highway nearest its centerline

timing.description: position held through the approach before intersection entry

judgment_calls_needed.note: The supplied law gives no numeric nearest-position cutoff; retain complete-body lateral geometry and source authority.

parameter_refs.name: approach_lateral_offset_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: measured nonnegative original complete-body offset in m
